old_lines_with_numerals.old_text: Cutoff: **2026-09-23 UTC**. Reviewed release: [Headroom v0.38.0](https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/releases/tag/v0.38.0), release commit `94206e265203acfd72a3b939e9a964e29175ad50`. Evaluate selected library capabilities before adopting its complete provider proxy.

old_lines_with_numerals.old_text: The [workspace](https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/blob/v0.38.0/Cargo.toml) includes `headroom-core`, `headroom-proxy`, Python bindings, simulators, and parity tooling under Apache-2.0. The [core exports](https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/blob/v0.38.0/crates/headroom-core/src/transforms/mod.rs) include `LogCompressor`, `SearchCompressor`, `CompressionPipelineBuilder`, `JsonMinifier`, and recovery-aware pipeline types. Describing Headroom as Python-only or requiring a wholesale Rust rewrite is incorrect.
old_lines_with_numerals.disposition: Claim reconciled in heading disposition; source links repinned to current release where applicable. Older release numbers are not current benchmark qualifications.

old_lines_with_numerals.old_text: The [core manifest](https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom/blob/v0.38.0/crates/headroom-core/Cargo.toml) declares internal crate version **0.1.0**, not product version 0.38.0. ML is enabled by default; `default-features = false` excludes optional ONNX/embedding/classifier dependencies. The remaining core still includes tokenizers, grammars, SQLite, and network-capable dependencies. Feature exclusion is not proof of a small binary, offline operation, or a successful build on every Jackin target.

old_lines_with_numerals.old_text: Cutoff: **2026-09-23 UTC**. Reviewed release: [LemonCrow v0.7.4](https://github.com/lemoncrow-lab/lemoncrow/releases/tag/v0.7.4). LemonCrow is a serious integrated context-runtime candidate. Its current tagged tree includes `src/lemoncrow/pro`; rejecting it as missing that source would be incorrect. It is not, however, an independently proven winner for Jackin's workloads.
old_lines_with_numerals.disposition: Superseded current identity/date; previous release remains historical evidence only.

old_lines_with_numerals.old_text: The [runtime documentation](https://github.com/lemoncrow-lab/lemoncrow/blob/v0.7.4/README.md) describes ranked code search, targeted reads, edits, shell execution, and web fetching. The full host integration aims to replace overlapping native tools rather than simply add another catalog. This can reduce exploration cycles, but also changes the agent's tool contracts and behavior.
old_lines_with_numerals.disposition: Claim reconciled in heading disposition; source links repinned to current release where applicable. Older release numbers are not current benchmark qualifications.

old_lines_with_numerals.old_text: The [tagged source directory](https://github.com/lemoncrow-lab/lemoncrow/tree/v0.7.4/src/lemoncrow/pro) and [engine package](https://github.com/lemoncrow-lab/lemoncrow/blob/v0.7.4/src/lemoncrow/pro/__init__.py) are present. The [license](https://github.com/lemoncrow-lab/lemoncrow/blob/v0.7.4/LICENSE) declares Apache-2.0 across the source, including the engine. This resolves the specific source-directory availability concern, not every reproducibility question. This review did not reproduce the release build or audit every bundled dependency.
old_lines_with_numerals.disposition: Claim reconciled in heading disposition; source links repinned to current release where applicable. Older release numbers are not current benchmark qualifications.

old_lines_with_numerals.old_text: The tagged [smart-state implementation](https://github.com/lemoncrow-lab/lemoncrow/blob/v0.7.4/src/lemoncrow/gateway/adapters/mcp/smart_state.py) uses nonblocking flock attempts and a deadline, with a five-second default. It still describes cumulative state shared across sibling processes. Bounded contention is better than an unbounded wait, but hot-path advisory counters and shared state still require load tests and capsule scoping.
old_lines_with_numerals.disposition: Retained with fuller/legacy MCP scope; not a Lite index lock.

old_lines_with_numerals.old_text: The maintainer [confirms the worktree fix landed](https://github.com/lemoncrow-lab/lemoncrow/pull/46#issuecomment-5570558170). The proposal's documented process-global working-directory inference is not a sufficient multi-session isolation contract for Jackin. Use an explicit per-session root, or a separate process per worktree; do not infer another session's root from its last shell command.
old_lines_with_numerals.disposition: Claim reconciled in heading disposition; source links repinned to current release where applicable. Older release numbers are not current benchmark qualifications.

old_lines_with_numerals.old_text: The current [benchmark document](https://github.com/lemoncrow-lab/lemoncrow/blob/v0.7.4/BENCHMARKS.md) links author-produced runs, data, and a combined runtime/persona treatment. Those runs do not establish an independent 0.7.4 result. A benchmark copied into a new release does not become a benchmark of that release. A single repetition cannot distinguish a regression from noise reliably. JetBrains has not validated this runtime in the three cited policy/filter articles.
